meaning: The comment fixes the ICP panel's three-layer draw order (pulsatile band, recording at 0.4 opacity, non-pulsatile mean on top) and records that an alternative — mean last at 0.5 with a halo — was tried and rejected. It is a claim about a past visual comparison, not code that runs.

could_move.what: Every ICP data panel inherits this layering; editing the loop order changes which curve is occluded during the compression window
The recording scatter is drawn after the pulse runs; swapping these blocks would put the measurement over the mean and contradict the comment
Patient-deck comparison figures reuse the same panel

expectation: Visual only: no effect on fitted parameters or residuals. The 0.4/0.5 opacity values and the halo legibility claim cannot be verified from this context, so I cannot tell whether the stated comparison still reflects the current code.

check.why: Regenerates the one panel so the layering can be eyeballed against the comment, without re-fitting.
